## Verdict

missing

## Bearer

PayloadCodec — core-sync/src/main/kotlin/com/mgilli/core/sync/transport/PayloadCodec.kt

## Trigger

None — the fix is a `serialVersionUID` declaration on each `Serializable`
class, not a call. Nothing needs to observe it.

## Today

`PayloadCodec.kt` declares eight private `Serializable` data classes —
`SegmentSnapshot`, `RetainedFactorSnapshot`, `RejectedCalibrationSnapshot`,
`RaceSnapshot`, `ProfileSnapshot`, `RaceHistoryEntrySnapshot`,
`ProfileSyncPayloadSnapshot` and `RecordedRacePayloadSnapshot` — none of
them declares a `serialVersionUID`. Kotlin derives one from the class
structure at compile time, and `:app-phone` and `:app-wear` build and
ship this file independently.

## Expected

Each of the eight classes declares its own `serialVersionUID` as a fixed
`private const val` of type `Long`, so a field added, reordered or
retyped on one side does not silently change the derived identifier and
break decoding on the other side.

PayloadCodec, Serializable, serialVersionUID, ObjectOutputStream
